items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: Yes, I knew Red, and his brother Dick.

ctx.x: Did you know Red Mackey by any chance?

Yes, I knew Red, and his brother Dick. And, well, Dick was the trumpet player with the owl band that played at the rowing club, not the band that recorded. That's what I was trying to... The other band.
I got him confused. I was thinking of Dick. Yeah. And I said Red.
